title: Subtraction Facts
subtitle: Within 10, up to 100
bounds: PROTOCOL 4c, prompt s − a = ? read as the addition fact a + b = s backwards, a and b at least 1. Minuend s per tier: T1 2-10, T2 11-20 (a, b at least 2, min(a, b) at most 9, at least half one digit taken from a number that crosses ten), T3 21-40, T4 41-70, T5 71-100 (a, b at least 2; at least half regroup, at least a quarter take a one-digit number from two digits, at most a quarter have a multiple of 10 as s, a or the answer). Wrong choices: distinct non-negative integers up to 999, at least two within 1, 2 or 10 of the answer, at most one far.

tiers.name: Within 10
tiers.description: Subtract from numbers up to 10. Think: what adds up?

tiers.name: Within 20
tiers.description: Subtract from 11 to 20, often crossing ten (13 - 5).

tiers.name: Within 40
tiers.description: Take away from 21 to 40. Tens first, then ones.

tiers.name: Within 70
tiers.description: Take away from 41 to 70. Trade a ten when you need to.

tiers.name: Within 100
tiers.description: Take away from 71 to 100. Tens first, then ones.

ONE_OFF.student: Off by one. Check: answer + number taken away must equal the start.
ONE_OFF.teacher: Counted back one step too many or too few: answer is the correct difference plus or minus 1.

ADDED.student: Take away, don't add. Subtracting makes the number smaller.
ADDED.teacher: Added the two numbers (s + a) instead of subtracting.

SMALLER_FROM_LARGER.student: Don't flip digits. If the top digit is smaller, trade a ten for 10 ones.
SMALLER_FROM_LARGER.teacher: In each place takes the smaller digit from the larger (14 - 6 gives 12; 52 - 38 gives 26) instead of regrouping.

FORGOT_TRADE.student: You traded a ten for ones, so the tens digit has to drop by one.
FORGOT_TRADE.teacher: Regrouped the ones but left the tens unchanged: answer is 10 too big (14 - 6 gives 18; 52 - 38 gives 24).

TENS_SLIP.student: The tens are off by one ten. Check: answer + taken away = start.
TENS_SLIP.teacher: Right ones, tens digit one too high or too low: answer is the correct difference plus or minus 10.
